name: 45106 · Bethel, OH
findings: ZIP 45106 (Bethel) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45106 (Bethel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45106 (Bethel) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
